long_biography.plain_text:
After five decades in conventional contracting, Murphy turned to a different construction problem: a composite structural system assembled from interlocking blocks. As a co-founder of Renco USA, he helped spend twelve years developing the material and bringing it into a Florida apartment project. A small crew erected the walls, floors and roofs using blocks, adhesive and hand tools, extending his work from project delivery into construction technology.

That interest in practical building methods reflects a career formed on job sites. Murphy earned a contractor's licence at 19 after working with his father on building projects. He has said that seeing a site become a finished structure remains central to his motivation. The same emphasis on durable relationships later shaped the operating philosophy used across his Florida construction work.
